scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 16 boards from eight live T7/T8 benchmark games of 2026-11-26 (6p Continents, Online) holding Margaret Mead or Charles Darwin with an empty activation-plot list. Each board is the run's events.jsonl cut after turn N+1 and replayed at turn N. Both arms run one frozen ci-profile civvis_orders --resumed built from the branch, with the run's own requested genome (why.log line 1 forced, each as --with) and its own victory target and civilization; the on arm adds --with foreign-site-buys-the-open-border. 16 of 16 complete. Stranded boards (every known site in a major's land with no Open Borders): Mead, Ethiopia 180657Z t143 t156 t170 and Russia 094623Z t147 t160 t175: 6 of 6 on arms close a grant and add one 'buy OPEN_BORDERS' order at the bridge's 28 ceiling (Canada, Mongolia, Zulu, Khmer, Khmer, Norway; quoted 22-25 Gold); off arms none.
